title: A unit differential entry splits off an identity complex
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $C_\bullet$ be a chain complex of finite free $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-free-module], with differential $d_i:C_i\to C_{i-1}$ and $d_{i-1}d_i=0$ for every $i$. If some matrix coefficient of one $d_i$ in finite bases of $C_i$ and $C_{i-1}$ is a unit, then $C_\bullet$ is isomorphic as a chain complex to $C'_\bullet\oplus T_\bullet$, where every $C'_j$ is finite free, $C'_i$ and $C'_{i-1}$ have ranks one less than $C_i$ and $C_{i-1}$ respectively, $C'_j$ has the same rank as $C_j$ for every other $j$, and $T_\bullet$ is zero outside degrees $i$ and $i-1$ and is $R\xrightarrow{1}R$ in those two degrees.
